title: Transmitter reset doesn't work on G6
symptom: The 'hard reset transmitter' command has no effect on a G6 transmitter. No popup message appears and nothing is logged, even with native mode on/off and engineering mode enabled.
cause: The issue was likely on the user's side, possibly related to using an SW3 watch as a collector, as the developer stated it won't work with SW3 and must be completely disabled.
fix: Ensure the SW3 collector is completely disabled before attempting the transmitter reset. The user later confirmed the issue was on their side and planned to test with a different setup.
evidence_quote: It wont work with SW3 make sure that is completely disabled before you try.
